reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Alex Rampell, General Partner at Andreessen Horowitz.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Alex Rampell, General Partner at Andreessen Horowitz. Alex has a long history in fintech, having co-founded six companies in his career, including Affirm and TrialPay. During our conversation, we cover Alex’s framework for positive selection in investing, why the best investments are often operating systems or systems of record.
